 "command": "cat > programs/task-587d67df.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    base = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v != 0 for v in row)), None)
    if base is None:
        return out
    marker_height = {2: 4, 8: 3}
    for c, color in enumerate(grid[base]):
        height = marker_height.get(color, 0)
        for d in range(1, min(height, base + 1)):
            out[base - d][c] = color if d == height - 1 else 1
    return out
PY
